_contract: Cumulative cost of the D1 engineering GPU qualification, across every resource and subrun. A rerun does NOT reset it.
_package_id: the C1 execution package, so the deriver charges this to its GPU ENGINEERING allowance -- which is the book the 2026-10-03 amendment raised for exactly this work.
_teardown_reserve: held back so a session that reaches its ceiling can still be torn down and reconciled rather than discovering it cannot afford to stop.
authorizes: nothing by itself; a session still needs the live price, the limit checks and the same-failure gate to pass
